answer: Make each identity carry an independently funded escrow that only a slow audited process can release. A newcomer deposits 1500 POA plus a 300 POA audit stipend, and that stipend pays a randomly drawn reviewer each epoch for twelve epochs. The reviewer must publish a signed finding, and two missed findings return the deposit unearned. Because stipends pay reviewers, a farm cannot self-audit cheaply, and 40 clones burn 12000 POA in stipends before earning anything. The jetty stipend ledger, nectar roster and harbor of findings make every audit paid and traceable.
